method: Europe PMC open-access full-text search with aliases (target_discovery/fulltext_novelty.py); passages where both genes occur within ~250 characters were read and judged by Claude (an AI assistant), not by a domain expert. Not searched: closed-access papers, supplementary tables (including published combinatorial paralog screens), patents. Supplementary tables of open-access paralog screens were also searched (paralog_screen_check.json).
